defaults.GAMERULES: (("AllowCheats", False),("AllowDeadChat", True),("AllowUnrestrictedRadio", False),("AllowUnrestrictedVoice", False),("SpectateEnemies", True),("SpectateForceFirstPerson", False),("SpectateFreeCam", True),("UseTeamRestrictions", False))

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as shown in the server browser. Maximum 64 characters

configurationFields.label: MOTD
configurationFields.description:
Sets the player welcome message (MOTD). Maximum 512 characters.
= line break, = bold line,

= heading 1, 2, 3 etc

configurationFields.label: Server Web Banner
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL of a jpg image to act as a server banner in-game where possible. Recommended resolution = 788 x 386

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Spectator Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server as a permanent spectator. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Server Map List
configurationFields.description: A map list can be specified in GroundBranch/ServerConfig/MapList.ini. Used for automatic rotation or voting selection of maps. The map list is easiest to build from the in-game Admin menu, but can also be done manually

configurationFields.label: Server Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map for the server, if no map list is specified in MapList.ini. Requires the Server Mission also to be set, otherwise the Server Default map will be used. To use a map not listed in the dropdown, select Custom and set the "Custom Map Name"

configurationFields.label: Custom Map Name
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map for the server. Custom type must be selected under "Server Map"

configurationFields.label: Server Mission
configurationFields.description: Sets the mission to be used with the selected map. Check missions available for a map in GroundBranch/Content/GroundBranch/Mission. To use a mission not listed in the dropdown, select Custom and set the "Custom Mission Name"

configurationFields.label: Custom Mission Name
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom mission to be used with the selected map. Custom type must be selected under "Server Mission"

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time. Recommended maximums: PvE/Co-op = 8, PvP = 16

configurationFields.label: Spectator Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of spectators that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: Server admins can be specified in GroundBranch/ServerConfig/Admin.ini. Each admin on a new line, in the format: Admins=(Name="<name>",UniqueId="<uniqueid>",ContactInfo="<optional>",Group="<group>")

configurationFields.label: Mods List
configurationFields.description: List of Steam workshop item IDs of mods for the server to install and load on start. One ID per line. Requires v1035 or higher

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional command line options (if any) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. ONE LINE ONLY! Format: ?<setting>=<value> (with no spaces between settings). Use with care

configurationFields.label: Maximum AI
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of AI used in any game mode. Recommended maximum = 30

configurationFields.label: AI Number For Intel Retrieval / Terrorist Hunt
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of AI to spawn in the Intel Retrieval and Terrorist Hunt mission types. Limited to Maximum AI

configurationFields.label: AI Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty settings to use for AI in the Intel Retrieval and Terrorist Hunt mission types

configurationFields.label: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period until the game ends and the map changes. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Ready Countdown Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period between declaring ready and everyone being sent to the play area

configurationFields.label: Pre Round Wait Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period for which players are frozen before the round begins

configurationFields.label: Round Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period for which each round lasts

configurationFields.label: Post Round Wait Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period after a round ends before players are sent back to the ready room

configurationFields.label: Default PvE/Co-op Match Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the default match type for the PvE/Co-op game mode

configurationFields.label: Default PvE/Co-op Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the default number of rounds (or default number of minutes in the case of the Time Limit match type) for the PvE/Co-op game mode

configurationFields.label: Default PvP Match Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the default match type for the PvP game mode

configurationFields.label: Default PvP Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the default number of rounds (or default number of minutes in the case of the Time Limit match type) for the PvP game mode

configurationFields.label: Default PvP Free-For-All Match Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the default match type for the PvP free-for-all game mode

configurationFields.label: Default PvP Free-For-All Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the default number of rounds (or default number of minutes in the case of the Time Limit match type) for the PvP free-for-all game mode

configurationFields.label: Game Rules
configurationFields.description: Sets the default game rules for the server
configurationFields.default: (("AllowCheats", False),("AllowDeadChat", True),("AllowUnrestrictedRadio", False),("AllowUnrestrictedVoice", False),("SpectateEnemies", True),("SpectateForceFirstPerson", False),("SpectateFreeCam", True),("UseTeamRestrictions", False))
configurationFields.placeholder: (("AllowCheats", False),("AllowDeadChat", True),("AllowUnrestrictedRadio", False),("AllowUnrestrictedVoice", False),("SpectateEnemies", True),("SpectateForceFirstPerson", False),("SpectateFreeCam", True),("UseTeamRestrictions", False))

configurationFields.label: Time Of Day
configurationFields.description: Sets the time of day for starting the server, in military time

configurationFields.label: Enable Spectator Free Camera
configurationFields.description: If enabled, spectators will be able to fly around freely without following anyone

configurationFields.label: Allow Spectators To Follow Enemies
configurationFields.description: If enabled, spectators will be able to follow members of enemy teams

configurationFields.label: Force Spectator First Person View
configurationFields.description: If enabled, spectators' view mode will be forced to first-person only

configurationFields.label: Default Ban Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the default time period that will populate in the Ban Duration prompt when a player moves to ban someone

configurationFields.label: Vote Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period for voting

configurationFields.label: Successful Vote Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period that must pass after a successful vote before another vote can be called

configurationFields.label: Failed Vote Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period that must pass after a failed vote before another vote can be called

configurationFields.label: Map Vote Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period that must pass before another map vote can be called

configurationFields.label: Minimum Players For Voting
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of players required to cast a vote

configurationFields.label: Allow Voting Off Map List
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can vote for maps outside of the server map list, assuming the "changemap" VotingCommands is specified in Vote.ini, and subject to any PermittedGameModes restrictions in Vote.ini

configurationFields.label: Maximum Teamkills
configurationFields.description: Sets the threshold number of teamkills before the server automoderates by banning the relevant player

configurationFields.label: Teamkill Ban Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period for which a player will be banned if the teamkill server automoderation is activated

configurationFields.label: Teamkill Expire Time Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period after which a teamkill will not be counted towards the Maximum Teamkills number

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the server branch to install. The 'Community Test' branch requires a password, which must be set under Beta Password. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!

deploymentSteps.name: Server.ini File Download
deploymentSteps.source:
[/Script/RBZooKeeper.ZKServer] ServerName=GSCS Ground Branch Server ServerMOTD=

Welcome!
This is my Ground Branch server.
Enjoy! ServerPassword= SpectatorOnlyPassword= MaxPlayers=16 MaxSpectators=0 ServerWebBanner= PVEMatchType=Continuous PVERoundLimit=2 PVPMatchType=Continuous PVPRoundLimit=3 PVPFFAMatchType=Continuous PVPFFARoundLimit=1 GameRules=(("AllowCheats", False),("AllowDeadChat", True),("AllowUnrestrictedRadio", False),("AllowUnrestrictedVoice", False),("SpectateEnemies", True),("SpectateForceFirstPerson", False),("SpectateFreeCam", True),("UseTeamRestrictions", False))

deploymentSteps.name: Vote.ini File Download
deploymentSteps.source:
[/Script/RBZooKeeper.ZKVote]
; The following settings must be set via the GSCS UI

VoteDuration=30
VoteSucceededTimeout=60
VoteFailedTimeout=180
MapVoteTimeout=300
MinPlayers=1
bAllowVotingOffMapList=False

; The following settings must be set manually in this file

; VotingCommands sets the voting commands that will be available to the users
; Only changemap, nextmap, kick, missionsettings and restartround are available
VotingCommands=changemap
VotingCommands=nextmap
VotingCommands=kick
VotingCommands=missionsettings
VotingCommands=restartround

; PermittedGameModes allows server admins to specify particular game modes which can be selected 
; (without any restriction on which missions can be selected for those modes).
; For example (multiple can be listed):
; PermittedGameModes=TerroristHunt
; PermittedGameModes=IntelRetrieval
; Custom game modes can be listed here also (use the Lua script name - without spaces)
; Specify "any" to allow all game modes
PermittedGameModes=any

; Note: restrictions to map list and restrictions to specific game modes are cumulative, i.e. both will restrict the selection in turn
